# Connect4

> Public source index for LLMs and software agents. Read-only access requires no GitHub authentication.

## Primary entry points

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/Connect4/main/README.md): project overview and documentation entry point.
- [EVIDENCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/Connect4/main/EVIDENCE.md): evidence classes, claim scope, validation limits, and external-validation path.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/Connect4/main/AGENTS.md): repository-specific agent instructions and authority rules.
- [Agent access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/Connect4/main/.agent/ACCESS.md): anonymous access routes and precedence notes.
- [LICENSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/Connect4/main/LICENSE): license terms.

## Evidence status

- Evidence registry: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/Connect4/main/EVIDENCE.md
- Machine claims: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/Connect4/main/evidence/claims.json
- Strongest current external correctness result: IsoMax **192/192 W/D/L matches, 0 mismatches** on deterministic published Pascal Pons benchmark slices (32 L1_R1 + 32 L1_R2 + 64 L2_R1 + 64 L3_R1).
- Scope: parent-position W/D/L correctness only; no comparative-performance, per-move-score, CUDA-BSFP, or third-party-reproduction claim.
- Solver evidence index: https://github.com/iteathen/Connect4/blob/solver/isometric/evidence/external/README.md

## Anonymous source access

- Repository: https://github.com/iteathen/Connect4
- Git clone: `https://github.com/iteathen/Connect4.git`
- Raw files: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/Connect4/main/
- ZIP snapshot: https://codeload.github.com/iteathen/Connect4/zip/refs/heads/main
- tar.gz snapshot: https://codeload.github.com/iteathen/Connect4/tar.gz/refs/heads/main

Prefer Git, raw HTTPS, or codeload over the GitHub REST API when possible. Follow repository-local authority and agent instructions.
